subtitle: Lesson 15 · The Weekly Sales & Fulfillment Report

code:
"Can I see what percentage of orders are shipping
 late, broken out by region and subcategory?"

-- "Late" = ShipDate > DueDate.
-- Both columns already pulled back in Lesson 3.
caption: A vague-sounding ask with an exact, buildable definition underneath.

eyebrow: Extend the view, not a workaround
code:
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_CarrawayWeeklySalesFact AS
SELECT soh.SalesOrderID, /* ...existing columns... */,
  CASE WHEN soh.ShipDate > soh.DueDate
       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IsLate
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS soh
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS sod ON ...
WHERE soh.Status = 5;
caption: Fact just gains a column on refresh — no relationships break.

code:
% Shipped Late =
DIVIDE (
    CALCULATE ( [Order Count], Fact[IsLate] = 1 ),
    [Order Count]
)
caption: A boolean filter, not ALL() — respects the page's existing filters.
